evidence.excerpt: We introduce VEX-Bench, a unified benchmark for evaluating the verification complexity of LLM-generated misinformation, as perceived during screening, across models and generation methods.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We construct a benchmark spanning two misinformation categories, 6 high-stakes domains, and 60 real-world topics, and evaluate 7 frontier LLMs and 7 generation methods, yielding 5{,}880 articles.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
